Product Overview

Key Features

It's humiliating to have to collect or drain urine for patients. This medical drainage bag was designed with this function in mind. If the bag is sealed with an anti-reflex valve, the waste liquid will not flow backwards or leak. The 2000ml size holds plenty of liquid, and the long catcher makes each step quick and straightforward. Because it is constructed of medical silicone, it is soft, flexible, non-toxic, and safe. - With the help part, even the sufferer may accomplish the task quickly and effortlessly. - A clear bag has a detailed scale printed on it. - Anti-valve technology prevents urine from running backward, lowering the danger of retrograde infection for each user. Anti-valve technology keeps urine from flowing backwards, reducing infection risk.
